name: rosetta-quickselect-algorithm
code:
use default

quickselect(values: List[int], k: int) -> int is
    let pivot = values[values.count / 2]

    let lowers = values |> filter(v => v < pivot) |> collect()
    let pivots = values |> filter(v => v == pivot) |> collect()

    if k < lowers.count then
        quickselect(lowers, k)
    elif k < lowers.count + pivots.count then
        pivot
    else
        quickselect(
            values |> filter(v => v > pivot) |> collect(),
            k - lowers.count - pivots.count)
    fi
si

let values = [9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

for k in 0..values.count do
    write_line(
        "largest {k + 1}: {quickselect(values, values.count - 1 - k)}")

use default

quickselect(values: List[int], k: int) -> int is
    let pivot = values[values.count / 2]

    let lowers = values |> filter(v => v < pivot) |> collect()
    let pivots = values |> filter(v => v == pivot) |> collect()

    if k < lowers.count then
        quickselect(lowers, k)
    elif k < lowers.count + pivots.count then
        pivot
    else
        quickselect(
            values |> filter(v => v > pivot) |> collect(),
            k - lowers.count - pivots.count)
    fi
si

let values = [9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

for k in 0..values.count do

        "largest {k + 1}: {quickselect(values, values.count - 1 - k)}")
